summary: LLM API pricing in late 2026 continues to trend downward at the low end while premium flagship models hold steady or rise. Prompt caching and batch discounts (typically 50%) are now near-universal, and most vendors maintain input/output pricing asymmetry where output tokens cost 4-5x input. Note that the live research data references future-dated or speculative model names (e.g., GPT-6, Gemini 4, Claude 5.x); this table only includes models that are publicly available today with confirmed published pricing as specified in the request.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.notes: Batch API offers 50% discount. Cached input priced at 50% of standard input. Tiered rate limits by usage tier.

models.name: GPT-4o mini
models.notes: Most cost-effective small OpenAI model. Batch API 50% discount available.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.notes: Prompt caching reads at ~10% of input price; cache writes cost extra. Batch processing 50% discount.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.notes: Free tier available with content used to improve products. Context caching and batch (50%) discounts offered. Large 1M context window.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Fastest, lowest-cost Claude tier. Prompt caching and batch discounts available.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.notes: Tiered pricing: higher rates apply for prompts over 200K tokens. Free tier available. Batch 50% discount.

models.name: o4-mini
models.notes: Reasoning model; output includes reasoning tokens. Batch API 50% discount.

models.name: o3
models.notes: Advanced reasoning model; output includes reasoning tokens. Price reduced in 2025. Batch 50% discount.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.8
models.notes: Flagship Claude model for complex tasks. Prompt caching reads ~10% of input. Batch 50% discount.

models.name: Grok (grok-4)
models.notes: Cached input discounted. Higher pricing tier for prompts exceeding 128K tokens.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (hosted)
models.notes: Open-weight model hosted via Together AI; flat per-token pricing. Free trial credits available. Also hosted by Groq and Fireworks at varying rates.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (Groq)
models.notes: Groq offers very high throughput inference. Free tier with rate limits available.

models.name: Mistral Large
models.notes: Free tier available via La Plateforme with rate limits. Batch API offers discounts.

models.name: Mistral Small
models.notes: Cost-effective small model. Free tier available via La Plateforme.

models.name: Llama 3.1 405B (Fireworks)
models.notes: Largest open Llama model hosted on Fireworks; flat pricing. Free trial credits available.

models.name: Command R+
models.notes: Free trial API keys with rate limits available. Optimized for RAG and tool use.
